message.content: It depends on what you’re looking for—action, drama, animation, or something that made a cultural splash—but if I had to pick one standout film from 2020, it would be **“Parasite”**. Though it premiered in 2019, it dominated the awards circuit in 2020, winning Best Picture at the Oscars and cementing its place as a cinematic masterpiece that blended social commentary with genre‑blending storytelling. If you’re after something more mainstream, “Tenet” and “Soul” were also huge hits that year, each offering a distinct experience—mind‑bending sci‑fi action and heartfelt animated music, respectively.
